title: git-next agent output (schema_version: 1)
description: Output schema for `git-next --agent`. Stable across patch versions within schema_version 1.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Increment when breaking changes are made to the output shape.

status.description: Overall repository safety status derived from the highest-severity active rule.

risk_level.description: Risk level matching the Severity of the highest-priority active rule.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of all active rule descriptions, joined by semicolons.

recommended_next_command.description: The command from the highest-priority active rule that is not a comment or OR-choice. Omitted when the repo is clean or when no unambiguous command exists.

allowed_commands.description: Git commands that are safe to run given the current state. Always includes baseline read-only commands (git status, git log, git diff, etc.). Excludes commands in blocked_commands.

blocked_commands.description: Git commands that the active rules prohibit. Derived from the rule-to-command mapping in internal/output/agent.go.

rules_triggered.description: All active (non-suppressed) rules that fired, in priority order (highest first).

description.description: Short human-readable description of the rule.

destructive.description: True if the suggested command can rewrite or permanently delete history.
